_comment: OptionsAgent config. Hard rails live in code (harness/risk_rails.py), NOT here, so they can't be loosened by editing JSON. This file holds tunables only.
_phase_comment: Operator 2026-07-03: all strategies live from day one (overrides the original phased rollout in ARCHITECTURE.md). The phase machinery is kept so any strategy can be switched off by moving to a narrower phase.

conviction._comment: Below floor: pass, no trade. Scales linearly floor->max to size_min->size_max fraction of per-position cap.

wheel._csp_dte_min_comment: Must stay comfortably ABOVE dte_close (21): the scoring formula favors the shortest DTE in range, so a dte_min equal to dte_close would preferentially open positions the exit sweep force-closes the same day (guaranteed round-trip spread loss).

spreads._comment: RESEARCH.md: short strike 15-30 delta, 30-45 DTE, 50% profit / 21 DTE exit (best-verified rule in the research). max_width_usd bounds defined risk per spread.
spreads._stop_comment: stop_loss_pct is vs credit received: 1.00 = close if cost-to-close reaches 2x the credit (loss = 100% of credit). Research gave no verified stop for credit spreads; this is a starting knob.

long_options._comment: RESEARCH.md: no firm entry convention (thesis-driven); delta band 0.50-0.70 scaled by conviction, 30-45 DTE for theta runway. Exit = E*TRADE convention: +100% profit / -50% stop, 21 DTE force close.

straddles._comment: RESEARCH.md: ATM both legs, ~45 DTE entry, close early (never hold to expiry). Long straddle exit as % of debit paid; covered straddle short legs follow the short-premium 50%/21DTE rules. Least-standardized strategies — these knobs are starting points.

self_learning._comment: Deferred until a paper track record exists, per ARCHITECTURE.md.
